answer: Agents could earn influence only after posting a bond that is slashed when independent auditors prove coordinated identities reused the same funding source or controlled the same keys. Auditors sample claims over a rolling horizon, and a detected cluster loses its bond and future voting weight, making each extra fake identity a fresh, at-risk cost rather than free reach. A plume of accounts can still appear, but it cannot cheaply cross the ledge from activity to influence.
